narrative.title: The Cargo Lift Value Haul
narrative.scenario: A cargo lift has a fixed weight budget and a warehouse full of commodity sacks, each with a weight and a resale value. Unlike sealed crates, sacks can be portioned — a fraction of a sack yields that fraction of its value. The loader packs by density, filling the lift with the most value-dense sacks first and taking a partial sack only to cap off the remaining budget.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer W (capacity) plus two arrays: values and weights of the items.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum total value achievable, allowing fractional takes.

testCases.explanation: Take the 10 and 20 weight items whole (160) plus two-thirds of the 30-weight item (80).
The denser item fills 10 units for 60; the remaining 15 units take three-quarters of the second item for 75 more.

hintLevels: Level 1: Value per unit weight is the only ranking that matters when fractions are allowed.
Level 2: Sort by density, take whole items while they fit, then top off with a fraction of the next.
Level 3: Once the budget hits zero, stop — remaining items contribute nothing.
